GoLaravel Documentation

Complete guide to building applications with GoLaravel.

Installation

Add GoLaravel to your Go project:

go get github.com/yourusername/golaravel

Quick Start

Create a new application and start the server:

package main

import (
    "golaravel/app"
    "golaravel/app/http/request"
    "golaravel/app/http/response"
)

func main() {
    application := app.New()
    
    application.Router.Get("/", func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
        return res.JSON(map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
    })
    
    application.Run(":5000")
}

Service Container

The service container provides dependency injection with bindings and singletons.

Binding Services

container := container.New()

// Regular binding (new instance each time)
container.Bind("logger", func(c *container.Container) interface{} {
    return NewLogger()
})

// Singleton (same instance always)
container.Singleton("database", func(c *container.Container) interface{} {
    return NewDatabaseConnection()
})

// Store an existing instance
container.Instance("config", myConfig)

Resolving Services

logger, err := container.Make("logger")
if err != nil {
    // Handle error
}

db, _ := container.Make("database")

Routing

Define expressive routes with support for parameters, groups, and middleware.

Basic Routes

router := routing.NewRouter()

router.Get("/", homeHandler)
router.Post("/users", createUserHandler)
router.Put("/users/{id}", updateUserHandler)
router.Delete("/users/{id}", deleteUserHandler)

Route Parameters

router.Get("/users/{id}", func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
    id := req.Param("id")
    return res.JSON(map[string]string{"id": id})
})

router.Get("/posts/{post}/comments/{comment}", func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
    postID := req.Param("post")
    commentID := req.Param("comment")
    // ...
})

Route Groups

router.Group("/api", func(r *routing.Router) {
    r.Use(middleware.Auth(validateToken))
    
    r.Get("/users", listUsersHandler)
    r.Post("/users", createUserHandler)
    
    r.Group("/v1", func(r *routing.Router) {
        r.Get("/products", listProductsHandler)
    })
})

Named Routes

router.Get("/users/{id}", showUserHandler).Name("users.show")

// Get URL for named route
url := router.Route("users.show", map[string]string{"id": "123"})
// Returns: /users/123

Middleware

Built-in middleware for common tasks.

Available Middleware

Middleware Description
Logger() Logs incoming requests with timing
Recovery() Recovers from panics and returns 500 error
CORS(origins) Handles Cross-Origin Resource Sharing
Auth(validator) Token-based authentication
BasicAuth(users) HTTP Basic Authentication
RateLimiter(limit, window) Rate limiting by IP
SecureHeaders() Adds security headers
Timeout(duration) Request timeout handling
ContentType(types) Validates Content-Type header
TrimStrings() Trims whitespace from string inputs

Using Middleware

// Global middleware
router.Use(middleware.Logger())
router.Use(middleware.Recovery())
router.Use(middleware.CORS("*"))

// Group middleware
router.Group("/api", func(r *routing.Router) {
    r.Use(middleware.Auth(validateToken))
    r.Use(middleware.RateLimiter(100, time.Minute))
})

Custom Middleware

func MyMiddleware() routing.MiddlewareFunc {
    return func(next routing.HandlerFunc) routing.HandlerFunc {
        return func(req *request.Request, res *response.Response) error {
            // Before handler
            log.Println("Before request")
            
            err := next(req, res)
            
            // After handler
            log.Println("After request")
            
            return err
        }
    }
}

Request

The Request object provides convenient access to HTTP request data.

Input Methods

// Route parameters
id := req.Param("id")

// Query string
page := req.Query("page", "1")       // With default
allQuery := req.QueryAll()           // All query params

// JSON body
var user User
req.JSON(&user)

// Form input
name := req.Input("name", "default")

// All input (merged query + body)
all := req.All()

Request Information

req.Method()           // "GET", "POST", etc.
req.URL()              // Full URL
req.IP()               // Client IP
req.UserAgent()        // User agent string
req.Header("Accept")   // Get header value
req.Headers()          // All headers
req.Cookie("session")  // Get cookie value
req.BearerToken()      // Extract Bearer token

Checks

req.Has("email")       // Check if input exists
req.Filled("email")    // Check if input exists and not empty
req.IsMethod("POST")   // Check HTTP method
req.IsAjax()           // Check X-Requested-With header
req.WantsJSON()        // Check Accept header
req.Accepts("text/html") // Check Accept header

Response

Build HTTP responses with a fluent API.

Response Types

// JSON response
res.JSON(map[string]string{"status": "ok"})

// HTML response
res.HTML("<h1>Hello World</h1>")

// Plain text
res.String("Hello World")

// Redirect
res.Redirect("/dashboard")

// No content (204)
res.NoContent()

// File download
res.Download("/path/to/file.pdf", "document.pdf")

Status Codes & Headers

// Set status code
res.Status(201)

// Set headers
res.Header("X-Custom-Header", "value")

// Chain methods
res.Status(201).Header("Location", "/users/1").JSON(user)

Error Responses

res.NotFound("User not found")
res.BadRequest("Invalid input")
res.Unauthorized("Please login")
res.Forbidden("Access denied")
res.InternalServerError("Something went wrong")
res.ValidationError(errors)

Validation

Laravel-style validation rules for your data.

Basic Usage

data := map[string]interface{}{
    "name":  "John",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "age":   25,
}

rules := map[string][]string{
    "name":  {"required", "min:2", "max:50"},
    "email": {"required", "email"},
    "age":   {"required", "integer", "between:18,100"},
}

v := validation.Make(data, rules)

if v.Fails() {
    errors := v.Errors()
    // Handle validation errors
}

if v.Passes() {
    // Validation passed
}

Available Rules

Rule Description
requiredField must be present and not empty
nullableField can be empty (skips other rules if empty)
emailMust be valid email format
urlMust be valid URL
min:nMinimum length/value
max:nMaximum length/value
between:min,maxValue between min and max
size:nExact length
in:a,b,cValue must be one of listed options
not_in:a,b,cValue must not be listed
alphaOnly alphabetic characters
alpha_numOnly alphanumeric characters
numericMust be numeric
integerMust be integer
booleanMust be boolean
confirmedMust match field_confirmation
regex:patternMust match regex pattern
dateMust be valid date
uuidMust be valid UUID
ipMust be valid IP address
jsonMust be valid JSON

Database ORM

Query builder with a fluent interface.

Query Builder

qb := orm.NewQueryBuilder("users")

// SELECT with conditions
qb.Select("id", "name", "email").
   Where("active", "=", true).
   Where("age", ">", 18).
   OrderBy("created_at", "DESC").
   Limit(10).
   Offset(0)

sql := qb.ToSQL()
// SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE active = ? AND age > ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

Where Clauses

qb.Where("status", "=", "active")
qb.OrWhere("role", "=", "admin")
qb.WhereNull("deleted_at")
qb.WhereNotNull("email")
qb.WhereIn("id", []int{1, 2, 3})

Joins

qb.Join("posts", "users.id", "=", "posts.user_id")
qb.LeftJoin("profiles", "users.id", "=", "profiles.user_id")
qb.RightJoin("orders", "users.id", "=", "orders.user_id")

Grouping & Aggregates

qb.Select("department", "COUNT(*) as count").
   GroupBy("department").
   Having("COUNT(*)", ">", 5)

Models

type User struct {
    orm.Model
    Name  string
    Email string
}

user := &User{}
user.SetTable("users")
user.Fill(map[string]interface{}{
    "name": "John",
    "email": "john@example.com",
})

Transactions

Database transactions for atomic operations.

Using Transaction Closure

err := conn.Transaction(func(tx *orm.Connection) error {
    _, err := tx.Query("users").Insert(map[string]interface{}{
        "name": "John",
        "email": "john@example.com",
    })
    if err != nil {
        return err // Rollback on error
    }
    
    _, err = tx.Query("profiles").Insert(map[string]interface{}{
        "user_id": 1,
        "bio": "Hello World",
    })
    return err
})

if err != nil {
    // Transaction was rolled back
}

Manual Transaction Control

tx, err := conn.Begin()
if err != nil {
    return err
}

_, err = tx.Query("users").Insert(data)
if err != nil {
    tx.Rollback()
    return err
}

err = tx.Commit()
if err != nil {
    return err
}

Relationships

Eloquent-style model relationships.

HasOne

// User has one Profile
hasOne := conn.HasOne("profiles", "user_id", "id", userID)
row := hasOne.Get()
row.Scan(&profile.ID, &profile.Bio)

HasMany

// User has many Posts
hasMany := conn.HasMany("posts", "user_id", "id", userID)
rows, _ := hasMany.Get()
defer rows.Close()
for rows.Next() {
    var post Post
    rows.Scan(&post.ID, &post.Title)
}

BelongsTo

// Post belongs to User
belongsTo := conn.BelongsTo("users", "user_id", "id", post.UserID)
row := belongsTo.Get()
row.Scan(&user.ID, &user.Name)

BelongsToMany (Many-to-Many)

// User belongs to many Roles through role_user pivot table
belongsToMany := conn.BelongsToMany(
    "roles",        // related table
    "role_user",    // pivot table
    "user_id",      // foreign pivot key
    "role_id",      // related pivot key
    "id",           // parent key
    "id",           // related key
    userID,
)

rows, _ := belongsToMany.Get()

// Attach roles
belongsToMany.Attach([]interface{}{1, 2, 3})

// Detach roles
belongsToMany.Detach(2)

// Sync roles (replaces all)
belongsToMany.Sync([]interface{}{1, 3})

Migrations

Schema builder for database migrations.

Creating Tables

sql := migration.CreateTable("users", func(bp *migration.Blueprint) {
    bp.ID()                              // Auto-increment primary key
    bp.String("name", 255)
    bp.String("email", 255).Unique()
    bp.String("password", 255)
    bp.Boolean("active").Default("true")
    bp.Timestamps()                      // created_at, updated_at
    bp.SoftDeletes()                     // deleted_at
})

Column Types

Method SQL Type
ID()BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY
String(name, len)VARCHAR(len)
Text(name)TEXT
Integer(name)INTEGER
BigInteger(name)BIGINT
Float(name)REAL
Decimal(name, p, s)DECIMAL(p,s)
Boolean(name)BOOLEAN
Date(name)DATE
DateTime(name)TIMESTAMP
JSON(name)JSONB
UUID(name)UUID

Column Modifiers

bp.String("email", 255).Nullable().Unique()
bp.Integer("count").NotNull().Default("0")
bp.ForeignID("user_id").References("id").On("users").OnDelete("CASCADE")

Dropping Tables

sql := migration.DropTable("users")
sql := migration.DropTableCascade("users")

Views

Template engine for rendering HTML.

Basic Usage

v := view.New("./templates")

// Share data across all views
v.Share("appName", "My Application")

// Render a template
html, err := v.Render("home", map[string]interface{}{
    "title": "Welcome",
    "user":  currentUser,
})

Template Example

<!-- templates/home.html -->
<html>
<head>
    <title>{{.title}} - {{.appName}}</title>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>{{upper .title}}</h1>
    <p>Hello, {{.user.Name}}!</p>
</body>
</html>

Helpers

Utility functions for common operations.

String Helpers (Str)

support.Str.Slug("Hello World")        // "hello-world"
support.Str.Camel("hello_world")       // "helloWorld"
support.Str.Snake("HelloWorld")        // "hello_world"
support.Str.Studly("hello_world")      // "HelloWorld"
support.Str.Kebab("helloWorld")        // "hello-world"
support.Str.Title("hello world")       // "Hello World"
support.Str.Upper("hello")             // "HELLO"
support.Str.Lower("HELLO")             // "hello"
support.Str.Limit("Long text...", 10)  // "Long text..."
support.Str.Random(16)                 // Random string
support.Str.UUID()                     // UUID v4
support.Str.Contains("hello", "ell")   // true
support.Str.StartsWith("hello", "he")  // true
support.Str.EndsWith("hello", "lo")    // true
support.Str.Replace("hello", "l", "L") // "heLLo"
support.Str.Trim("  hello  ")          // "hello"
support.Str.Plural("user")             // "users"
support.Str.Singular("users")          // "user"

Collection Helpers

items := []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
col := support.Collect(items)

col.First()                // 1
col.Last()                 // 5
col.Count()                // 5
col.IsEmpty()              // false
col.Contains(3)            // true
col.Reverse()              // [5, 4, 3, 2, 1]
col.Chunk(2)               // [[1,2], [3,4], [5]]
col.Filter(func(x int) bool { return x > 2 })  // [3, 4, 5]
col.Map(func(x int) int { return x * 2 })      // [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
col.Sum()                  // 15

Carbon (Date/Time)

now := support.Carbon(time.Now())

now.DiffForHumans()        // "just now"
now.AddDays(5)
now.SubDays(3)
now.AddHours(2)
now.AddMinutes(30)
now.StartOfDay()
now.EndOfDay()
now.IsToday()
now.IsFuture()
now.IsPast()
now.Format("2006-01-02")

Configuration

Manage application configuration.

Basic Usage

cfg := config.New()

// Set values (supports dot notation)
cfg.Set("app.name", "My App")
cfg.Set("database.host", "localhost")
cfg.Set("database.port", 5432)

// Get values with defaults
name := cfg.GetString("app.name", "Default App")
port := cfg.GetInt("database.port", 3306)
debug := cfg.GetBool("app.debug", false)

Environment Variables

// Load from environment
cfg.LoadEnv("MYAPP")  // Loads MYAPP_* variables

// Access env values
host := config.Env("DATABASE_HOST", "localhost")
port := config.EnvInt("DATABASE_PORT", 5432)
debug := config.EnvBool("APP_DEBUG", false)

Checking Values

cfg.Has("database.host")   // true if key exists
cfg.All()                  // Get all config as map

Authentication

Secure password hashing and token-based authentication.

Password Hashing

import "golaravel/app/auth"

// Hash a password
hash, err := auth.Hash("secret123")

// Verify password
if auth.Check("secret123", hash) {
    // Password is correct
}

// Secure string comparison (timing-safe)
if auth.SecureCompare(token1, token2) {
    // Tokens match
}

// Generate random token
token := auth.GenerateToken(32)
// Returns: "a1b2c3d4e5f6..."

Token Guard

// Create guard with token resolver
guard := auth.NewTokenGuard(func(token string) (user, userID interface{}, err error) {
    // Look up user by token
    user, err := findUserByToken(token)
    if err != nil {
        return nil, nil, err
    }
    return user, user.ID, nil
})

// Authenticate with token
guard.SetToken("bearer-token-here")

// Check authentication
if guard.Check() {
    user := guard.User()
    id := guard.ID()
}

// Check if guest
if guard.Guest() {
    // Not authenticated
}

// Login user manually
guard.Login(user)

// Logout
guard.Logout()

Caching

In-memory cache store with expiration support.

Basic Operations

import "golaravel/app/cache"

store := cache.NewMemoryStore()

// Store a value (with 5 minute TTL)
store.Put("user:1", userData, 5*time.Minute)

// Store forever
store.Forever("settings", appSettings)

// Get a value
value, exists := store.Get("user:1")

// Get with default
value := store.GetDefault("missing", "default-value")

// Check existence
if store.Has("user:1") {
    // Key exists
}

// Delete
store.Forget("user:1")

// Clear all
store.Flush()

Remember Pattern

// Get from cache or compute and store
value := store.Remember("expensive-query", 10*time.Minute, func() interface{} {
    return computeExpensiveValue()
})

Increment/Decrement

store.Put("counter", 0, time.Hour)

newVal := store.Increment("counter", 1)  // Returns 1
newVal = store.Increment("counter", 5)   // Returns 6
newVal = store.Decrement("counter", 2)   // Returns 4

Sessions

Session management with flash data support.

Basic Usage

import "golaravel/app/session"

// Create session manager with memory store
store := session.NewMemoryStorage()
manager := session.NewManager(store)

// Create a new session
sess := manager.Create()

// Get session by ID
sess, err := manager.Get(sessionID)

// Store data
sess.Put("user_id", 123)
sess.Put("cart", []string{"item1", "item2"})

// Retrieve data
userID := sess.Get("user_id")
cart := sess.GetDefault("cart", []string{})

// Check existence
if sess.Has("user_id") {
    // Key exists
}

// Remove data
sess.Forget("cart")

// Clear all data
sess.Flush()

Flash Data

// Flash data is available for ONE request only
sess.Flash("message", "User created successfully!")
sess.Flash("error", "Invalid input")

// Pull flash data (get and remove)
message := sess.Pull("message")

// Keep flash data for another request
sess.Reflash()

// Age flash data (mark for removal)
sess.AgeFlashData()

Session Security

// Regenerate session ID (prevent fixation)
sess.Regenerate()

// Invalidate session (logout)
sess.Invalidate()

// Destroy session
manager.Destroy(sessionID)

Events

Event dispatcher for decoupled application architecture.

Basic Usage

import "golaravel/app/events"

dispatcher := events.NewDispatcher()

// Register a listener
dispatcher.Listen("user.created", func(data interface{}) {
    user := data.(User)
    sendWelcomeEmail(user)
})

// Multiple listeners for same event
dispatcher.Listen("user.created", func(data interface{}) {
    user := data.(User)
    createDefaultSettings(user)
})

// Dispatch an event
dispatcher.Dispatch("user.created", newUser)

Wildcard Listeners

// Listen to all user events
dispatcher.Listen("user.*", func(data interface{}) {
    logUserActivity(data)
})

Event Subscribers

// Subscriber groups related listeners
type UserEventSubscriber struct{}

func (s *UserEventSubscriber) Subscribe(d *events.Dispatcher) {
    d.Listen("user.created", s.onUserCreated)
    d.Listen("user.deleted", s.onUserDeleted)
}

func (s *UserEventSubscriber) onUserCreated(data interface{}) {
    // Handle user created
}

func (s *UserEventSubscriber) onUserDeleted(data interface{}) {
    // Handle user deleted
}

// Register subscriber
dispatcher.Subscribe(&UserEventSubscriber{})

Managing Listeners

// Check if event has listeners
if dispatcher.HasListeners("user.created") {
    // Has at least one listener
}

// Remove all listeners for an event
dispatcher.Forget("user.created")
